title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.27155v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate multi-horizon photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for grid stability, energy scheduling, and the efficient operation of PVbatterygrid systems. However, existing models often fail to jointly capture short-term variability and long-term temporal patterns, while lacking unified multi-horizon capability and interpretability. To address these limitations, this study proposes a novel hybrid deep learning framework that integrates a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and N-BEATS within an attention-based fusion architecture. The proposed model leverages TFT to learn short-term temporal dependencies and dynamic feature importance, while N-BEATS captures long-term trend and seasonal components through interpretable basis decomposition. An adaptive attention mechanism dynamically fuses both branches, enabling balanced multi-scale learning. The framework simultaneously generates forecasts for 30-minute, 2-hour, 6-hour, 12-hour,

translated_title: 一种用于鲁棒多时间尺度光伏功率预测的TFT-NBEATS混合框架
translated_abstract: 准确的多时间尺度光伏功率预测对电网稳定性、能量调度以及光伏-电池-电网系统的高效运行至关重要。然而，现有模型往往无法同时捕捉短期波动性和长期时间模式，并且缺乏统一的多时间尺度预测能力和可解释性。为解决这些局限性，本研究提出了一种新颖的混合深度学习框架，该框架在基于注意力的融合架构中集成了时序融合Transformer（TFT）和N-BEATS。所提出的模型利用TFT学习短期时间依赖关系和动态特征重要性，同时利用N-BEATS通过可解释的基函数分解捕捉长期趋势和季节性成分。自适应注意力机制动态融合两个分支，实现平衡的多尺度学习。该框架可同时生成30分钟、2小时、6小时、12小时等多个时间尺度的预测。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种将TFT与N-BEATS相结合并通过自适应注意力机制动态融合的混合深度学习框架，能够同时捕捉短期波动与长期趋势，实现具有可解释性的鲁棒多时间尺度光伏功率预测。
en_tdlr: A hybrid deep learning framework integrating TFT and N-BEATS with an adaptive attention fusion mechanism, which jointly captures short-term variability and long-term trends to achieve interpretable and robust multi-horizon photovoltaic power forecasting.
